workloads.name: text
workloads.declared: GET /text with no request header of its own: a short text from a route of the app. Touched: its answer brings no header line of its scope, so on the head it is given them in one pass in place of three stages. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.

workloads.name: api
workloads.declared: GET /api/value with no request header of its own: a short text from a route under an API. Touched: its answer takes the pass with the API's lines. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.

workloads.name: plain
workloads.declared: GET /private with no request header of its own: the record page for one visitor, about 6 KB, not kept. Touched: a page does not take the pass, and on the head meets the test that decides so before the stages it met on the base. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.
